experiment: Two-proportion z-tests between control-node ablation arms, using n_scored (not n_total)
note: Corrected version: the first pass of this file used n_total (999) for every arm, but arms c and d have large n_unscored counts (203 and 966 respectively) from hitting Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b real daily token-per-day (TPD) limit of 200,000 -- accuracy is computed only over SCORED rows (compute_arm_metrics), so the correct n for a proportion test is n_scored, not n_total. Arms a/b are unaffected: their verdict comes entirely from the RF, which never calls Groq, so n_scored == n_total == 999 for both regardless of LLM quota state.
